style: Warm, whimsical children's picture-book illustration. Bold, flat digital art with clean thick outlines, brightly saturated colors, soft seasonal lighting for each scene. Friendly, rounded character design. Single clear scene, no text or watermarks, no panel borders.
characters: Sam: a curious child about 7 years old with short black hair and a round face, wearing a cozy sweater. A big friendly tree stands outside Sam's bedroom window and appears in every scene, changing with the seasons.
cover: Sam sitting on a windowsill looking out at a big tree that is split into four seasonal quarters at once - blossoms on one side, full green leaves, orange autumn leaves, and snow - cheerful curious expression.
pages: Sam kneeling on a windowsill indoors, looking out at a big bare tree outside, notebook and crayons nearby, curious expression, soft morning light.
The same big tree now covered in pink and white blossoms and fresh green leaves, mild sunny spring day, a few birds nesting in the branches, Sam outside pointing up happily.
The same big tree now full of thick green leaves under a bright hot sun, Sam sitting in its shade wearing shorts and a sun hat, drinking from a water bottle.
The same big tree now covered in orange, red, and yellow leaves, some falling and swirling in a cool breeze, Sam jumping happily into a pile of fallen leaves wearing a light jacket.
The same big tree now completely bare with snow gently falling and a light dusting of snow on its branches, Sam bundled up in a warm coat, hat, and mittens, making a small snowball.

Sam sitting cross-legged in front of a colorful world globe, with a small dreamy vignette above showing a snowy mountain, a sunny beach, and a rainy jungle all at once, curious and delighted expression.
